instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. Launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to perform a simply supported beam analysis under a uniformly distributed load. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane (Y from 0 to 10, Z from 0 to 10) and extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 200 mm. This produces a beam with cross-section 10 mm x 10 mm and span 200 mm. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire beam. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the beam. Analysis Step: Create a Static, General step named Step-Load. Loads and Boundary Conditions: Create a reference point RP-1 at the geometric center of the left end face (X = 0, Y = 5 mm, Z = 5 mm) and establish a kinematic coupling constraint between RP-1 and that end face. Create a reference point RP-2 at the geometric center of the right end face (X = 200 mm, Y = 5 mm, Z = 5 mm) and establish a kinematic coupling constraint between RP-2 and that end face. At RP-1, constrain U1 = U2 = U3 = 0 and UR2 = UR3 = 0 to model a pinned support that permits rotation about the beam axis (UR1). At RP-2, constrain U2 = U3 = 0 and UR2 = UR3 = 0 to model a roller support that permits axial motion (U1) and rotation about the beam axis (UR1). Apply a pressure of 0.1 MPa downward on the beam top surface (Y = 10 mm face). This pressure is equivalent to a uniformly distributed load q = 1 N/mm. Discretization: Mesh the beam with a global seed size of 5 mm. Assign the element type appropriate three-dimensional solid element formulation and generate the mesh. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-Beam, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Post-Processing: Query the U2 displacement (deflection) at the bottom midpoint of the span (X = 100 mm, Y = 0 mm, Z = 5 mm). Query the maximum Mises stress at the midspan section (X approximately 100 mm). Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
